description: In d3d11.dll (overlay + pipeline), render the reconstructed full tooltip cleanly and legibly: translated NAME as a header, translated TYPE + wrapped DESCRIPTION, any game-mode/observation notes, then the full list of translated FACT lines (label: value). Keep matched-only display, Right Ctrl drag, F8 toggle, follow-mouse OCR; unmatched raw OCR stays in the LOG only. Also update CI packaging + install/uninstall scripts to ship data/skilldata/. CANNOT be compiled in this Linux sandbox; be meticulous about C++ correctness.
steps: Decide the overlay data contract. The bronco_ocr.dll now emits an ORDERED sequence of matched=1 BroncoOcrResult lines for one skill (name header, then type, description, notes, fact lines) as designed in FEAT-002. To let the overlay render structure (header styling vs. body vs. fact list) without re-parsing, add a lightweight 'kind' hint to BroncoOcrResult in src/ocr/ocr_api.h: `int lineKind;` where 0=generic/legacy line, 1=tooltip header (name), 2=tooltip type, 3=tooltip description, 4=tooltip note, 5=tooltip fact. Set lineKind in ocr_api.cpp when emitting tooltip lines (FEAT-002 emits them; here we add the field and populate it). Legacy single-line matches and raw fallback lines use lineKind=0. Update the loader path only if it copies structs field-by-field (it uses the struct directly, so no change needed beyond the header).
In src/overlay/imgui_overlay.h TranslatedEntry: add `int lineKind = 0;` so the pipeline can pass the hint to the overlay.

In src/pipeline/pipeline.cpp workerThread(): when building bronco::overlay::TranslatedEntry from each BroncoOcrResult, copy entry.lineKind = result.lineKind. Keep the existing per-line logging (log every OCR line, matched or not) unchanged so unmatched raw OCR remains ONLY in the log.

In src/overlay/imgui_overlay.cpp render(): replace the current flat matched-only list with a clean structured tooltip renderer. Under g_translationMutex, snapshot g_translations. Build the display from entries in order, keeping ONLY matched entries (entry.matched) with non-empty translated text, de-duplicated so repeated OCR frames do not stack identical content. Render by lineKind: kind 1 (name header) -> ImGui::PushFont not required; use ImGui::TextColored with a bright/accent color (e.g. ImVec4(1.0f,0.85f,0.4f,1.0f)) and a Separator after it; kind 2 (type) -> ImGui::TextColored dim/italic-like color (e.g. ImVec4(0.7f,0.8f,1.0f,1.0f)); kind 3 (description) -> ImGui::TextWrapped; kind 4 (note) -> ImGui::TextColored(ImVec4(0.7f,0.7f,0.7f,1.0f)) wrapped; kind 5 (fact) -> render as a bulleted list item via ImGui::BulletText or '- ' prefix + TextWrapped. For legacy kind 0 matched lines (no tooltip found), render as TextWrapped exactly like before so name-only matching still shows a translation. Keep a sensible cap: cap the number of rendered ENTRIES (e.g. 40) so a full tooltip fits but the panel cannot grow unbounded; keep de-dup of identical (kind,text) pairs.

Preserve all existing overlay behavior: the welcome message, the persistent 'Segure Ctrl Direito para mover o painel. F8 liga/desliga.' hint, the passive/unlocked drag gating (dragModifierHeld/g_captureMouse declared at function scope as now - do NOT move it into a block), NoMove|NoInputs when locked, the 'Aguardando texto para traduzir...' placeholder when there are no matched entries, and the full D3D11 state save/restore block. Only the middle content-rendering section changes.

Update .github/workflows/build-release.yml 'Package release' step to ship the new skilldata dataset: after creating the release dir, add `New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path "$releaseDir/data/skilldata"` and copy the dataset, e.g. `Copy-Item "data/skilldata/*" "$releaseDir/data/skilldata/" -Recurse`. Place it near the existing dictionaries copy. This ensures skills_tooltips.json ships in the release ZIP.

Update scripts/install.ps1: the installer copies the whole data/ tree via `Copy-Item "$dataSource\*" ... -Recurse`, so data/skilldata is copied automatically IF present in the package - verify this and add data/skilldata to the pre-flight validation only as a soft check (do NOT hard-fail if missing, since name-only translation still works). Add an informational message when skilldata is present.

Update scripts/uninstall.ps1: the current data/ removal only explicitly handles data/dictionaries and data/tessdata, then removes data/ if empty. Add explicit removal of data/skilldata (Remove-Item -Recurse) in the same block so uninstall fully cleans up, and include it in $hasBroncoData detection and the 'files to be removed' listing.

Update README.md config table to document the new 'skilldata_path' key (default 'data/skilldata') and briefly describe the full-tooltip reconstruction behavior (skill identified by name -> full translated tooltip: nome, tipo, descrição, observações, lista de efeitos).
acceptance_criteria: TranslatedEntry has an int lineKind field; pipeline.cpp copies result.lineKind into it; BroncoOcrResult in ocr_api.h has int lineKind and ocr_api.cpp sets it for every emitted line (0 for legacy/raw).

Overlay renders a clean structured tooltip: name as colored header + separator, type in an accent color, description wrapped, notes wrapped/dim, facts as a bulleted list; legacy kind-0 matched lines still render as before.

Overlay still shows the placeholder when no matched entries, keeps the drag hint and welcome message, keeps Right Ctrl drag gating with dragModifierHeld/g_captureMouse at function scope, keeps NoMove|NoInputs when locked, and keeps the D3D11 state save/restore block intact.
Unmatched raw OCR lines are NOT rendered on screen (only in the log).
build-release.yml packages data/skilldata into the release ZIP; install.ps1 copies it (soft-checked, no hard fail if absent); uninstall.ps1 removes data/skilldata.
README config table documents skilldata_path and the full-tooltip behavior.
Static review confirms C++ correctness: matching field additions across ocr_api.h/overlay/pipeline, balanced braces, no block-scoped var used outside its block, no undeclared identifiers.
verification: Static C++ review only (no compiler in sandbox): re-read imgui_overlay.cpp render() end-to-end confirming braces balance, dragModifierHeld/g_captureMouse remain at function scope, and the new content section compiles logically (valid ImGui calls, std::string c_str usage); confirm TranslatedEntry.lineKind, BroncoOcrResult.lineKind, and the pipeline copy all line up.
Grep build-release.yml for 'skilldata' to confirm packaging; grep install.ps1/uninstall.ps1 for skilldata handling.
Confirm README config table includes skilldata_path.
findings: Added `int lineKind` to BroncoOcrResult (ocr_api.h) and TranslatedEntry (imgui_overlay.h). In ocr_api.cpp the emitLine lambda now takes a lineKind arg; tooltip emits map name=1, type=2, description=3, note=4, fact=5, while name-only matches and raw fallback use 0. pipeline.cpp copies entry.lineKind = result.lineKind (per-line logging left unchanged so unmatched raw OCR stays log-only). Rewrote ONLY the middle content section of imgui_overlay.cpp render(): collects matched, non-empty entries in emit order into a local DisplayLine{kind,text} vector, de-dups on (kind + 0x1f + text), caps at 40, and renders by kind (1=TextColored gold header + Separator; 2=TextColored blue; 3=TextWrapped; 4=PushStyleColor gray + TextWrapped + PopStyleColor; 5=Bullet + SameLine + TextWrapped; 0/default=TextWrapped). Preserved welcome msg, drag hint, 'Aguardando texto...' placeholder, NoMove|NoInputs gating, and the full D3D11 save/restore block; dragModifierHeld and g_captureMouse remain at function scope (declared before the window block at line ~287, g_captureMouse.store used after ImGui::End() at line ~417) so the prior C2065 block-scope bug is NOT reintroduced. build-release.yml now creates $releaseDir/data/skilldata and Copy-Item's data/skilldata/* into it. install.ps1 has a SOFT check ($hasSkillData) with an informational message, no hard-fail; the existing Copy-Item data/* -Recurse ships skilldata automatically. uninstall.ps1 removes data/skilldata (added to $hasBroncoData detection, the removal block, and the 'files to be removed' listing). README config table documents skilldata_path (default data/skilldata) plus a new 'Tooltip completo traduzido' section. Config keys (skilldata_path) were already wired in FEAT-002 (config.h/config.cpp load+save + bronco_config.json) and the dataset exists at data/skilldata/pt-br/skills_tooltips.json. C++ CANNOT be compiled in this Linux sandbox (MSVC/vcpkg only); verification was static: field additions line up across the 4 files, brace count balanced (55/55, matching net-zero like the original), valid ImGui API only, std::string via c_str() for %s calls. CI builds on tag push (orchestrator side).
